label: IN-GAME story. Oliver's SSR/CRA ideas are his theory, not established science; FACT lines are checked science.
premise: You arrive as a newcomer in a fractured, scrambled reality. The strata (SSR layers) have slipped out of order. Climb them, uncover the hidden laws, invent with them and repair the timeline through the CRA.
objective: Reach the Source Stratum and complete the Realignment: gather the seven core laws across the worlds, win over or outwit the Shakespearean NPCs (each has their own agenda), then choose which reality to restore.
after: After the story the Omniverse is endless: New Genesis starts a fresh seed with deeper strata and harder challenges, and your Codex carries over.
lux_note: Lux comes mostly from understanding: discoveries, puzzles, inventions and wise choices. Fights give a little (capped).

laws.name: The Law of Decay
laws.q: Tritium's half-life is about 4,500 days. Roughly how many years is that?
laws.fact: Tritium (hydrogen-3) has a half-life of about 12.32 years, which is roughly 4,500 days.
laws.theory: In Oliver's SSR theory, 4500 marks the first rhythm of decay in the lattice.

laws.name: The Law of Halves
laws.q: After two half-lives, what fraction of a radioactive sample is left?
laws.fact: Each half-life halves what is left: after two half-lives, ½ × ½ = ¼ remains.
laws.theory: Oliver links 12.32 to how layers of the strata fade and renew.

laws.name: The Law of Drift
laws.q: Earth's axis slowly wobbles (precession). About how many years does it take to shift by one degree?
laws.fact: Axial precession moves about 1 degree every 71.6 years (about 72).
laws.theory: In Oliver's framework, 72 is the harmonic step between strata.

laws.name: The Law of Layers
laws.q: 144 is a square number. Which number squared makes 144?
laws.fact: 12 × 12 = 144, so 144 is 12 squared (and also called a gross).

laws.name: The Law of Trials
laws.q: Why do scientists repeat an experiment many times?
options: to make results reliable and spot mistakes
laws.fact: Repeating trials makes results more reliable and shows up random errors and anomalies.
laws.theory: Oliver's doctrine imagines a 144,000-trial protocol; the game runs 144 seeded trials (1/1000).

laws.name: The Law of the Great Year
laws.q: One full precession cycle of Earth's axis takes about how long?
laws.fact: A full precession cycle takes about 25,800 years (often rounded to 26,000).
laws.theory: Oliver calls this the Great Year, the longest rhythm of the CRA.

laws.name: The Law of Return
laws.q: Why do we add a leap day roughly every four years?
laws.fact: Earth takes about 365.26 days to orbit the Sun relative to the stars, so calendars add a leap day to keep up.
laws.theory: In Oliver's theory 365.26 closes the loop of the Realignment.

harmony.name: Harmony
harmony.text: You weave the strata back together with friends at your side. Every world keeps its own voice, in tune with the rest.

power.name: Power
power.text: You take the Source for yourself and hold the strata in place by will alone. Order returns, but it answers to you.

sacrifice.name: Sacrifice
sacrifice.text: You pour your own Lux into the Source. Reality heals; you begin again with nothing but what you understood.

stranger.name: The Stranger
stranger.text: You realise the newcomer was never new. You have walked these strata before, and you choose to leave a door open for the next traveller.

clue_hint: Some say the poet knows who the newcomer really is…

rewards.name: Hard duels (foes +2 levels, double combat XP)
